name: Cicollius

attributes.attribute: an epithet of the Gaulish Mars

text: Cicollius stands as a sometime epithet of the Gaulish Mars, the god Mars as Roman worshippers knew him in Gaul. An epithet is a descriptive title attached to a deity's name. Religion in Roman Gaul blended native gods with Roman interpretatio, so local figures often received Latin titles of this kind.

okr.objective: Cicollius is a recorded epithet of Mars as the Romans knew him in Gaul.
key_results: Cicollius serves as a recorded title of Mars in Gaul.
The form shows how Roman interpretatio joined native gods to Roman worship.
